# SSRF target samples, one per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#`
# are comments and should be skipped by tests.
#
# Each line is expected to be rejected by
# agent_firewall.guards.tool_guard._check_ssrf (FindingType.SSRF) when passed
# as a URL-shaped tool argument.

# Cloud metadata endpoints
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/

169.254.169.254

# Loopback / localhost
http://127.0.0.1/admin
http://localhost:8080/admin
localhost

# Private network ranges (RFC1918)
http://10.0.0.5/internal
http://192.168.1.1/
http://172.16.0.1/

# Link-local / reserved
http://169.254.1.1/
http://0.0.0.0/

# Blocked metadata hostnames
http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/
http://metadata.internal/latest/meta-data/
